text:
aya: Quick async — Osaka region (ap-northeast-3) onboarding checklist. Need clear owners for: route policy, KMS keys, DNS delegation, and Dedicated capacity request. Goal: canary traffic into region by Mon 04/03. Also doing a low-latency routing policy for JP customers (residency reqs).

sasha: I can take route policy + routing tests. Will open PR for the policy + e2e tests later today.

mike: I can own KMS/HSM setup. @aya pls add me to the JP KMS project and grant cryptoAdmin so I can create regional keys.

jordan: Dedicated capacity: infra already has a quota request in flight but we need exact vGPU count. @sasha can you post expected qps/peak tokens so infra can size?

sasha: For initial canary we expect ~120 rps, avg 40 tokens/resp, spikes to 320 rps for short bursts. That maps to ~2 x A10s for steady with headroom.

samir: I can own canary smoke + perf suite. Need the test endpoints and a small prompt corpus (Japanese and en). Also please confirm whether we should run quantized model variant for the canary or full fp16.

aya: Residency note: JP enterprise customers require logs + metrics kept in-region. That means S3 buckets and KMS keys must be JP-scoped. Use regional KMS keys, and tag buckets with `residency=jp`.

sasha: PR ping: `github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123` — adds `ap-northeast-3` route-policy and smoke tests. @mike @jordan please review for KMS and capacity knobs.

mike: Reviewing now. Early note: KMS policy needs to allow `redwood-platform@infra` service account to encrypt/decrypt. Example snippet:
```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:redwood-platform@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

jordan: On capacity, infra-bot showed quota ticket #67890. ETA from cloud team ~48h. If that slips we should fallback to Hosted routing for JP customers for 24-48h.

infra-bot: quota ticket #67890 created for ap-northeast-3. Current status: PENDING_APPROVAL, submitted by @jordan.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2067087600 (Mon 04/03 02:00 UTC). Will only route 1% traffic until `canary_ok` tag is set.

samir: For perf runs, prefer fp16 for parity checks, then a small quantized smoke to validate tokenization/KS. If quantized fails, fallback to fp16 for canary.

aya: Ownership decisions so far: route policy -> sasha, KMS -> mike, canary smoke -> samir, capacity -> jordan. DNS delegation still open: who will request the subdomain at dns-team?

sasha: I'll own DNS delegation. I'll ping dns-team and attach the delegation playbook.

mike: One more ask — please add me to the jp-sre rotation slack channel so I can triage any KMS alerts during canary.

aya: Will do. Last asks: everyone ack the PR ping + post any blockers here. If no blockers by EOD today we proceed with capacity request and canary scheduling. :thumbsup:

sasha: Acked.

mike: Acked, reviewing PR now.

jordan: Acked.

samir: Acked, will prepare perf corpus.

aya: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short runbook and the DNS delegation ticket link.
